topic: Teleport Beams LLM Proxy Guide: Delegated Identity for Production AI Agents
keyword: Teleport Beams LLM proxy delegated identity

competitors.title: Teleport Debuts Delegated Agentic Identity and LLM Proxy in Beams Public Beta (Official Press Release, June 16, 2026)
key_points: Two foundational Agentic Identity Framework capabilities launched in Beams public beta: LLM Proxy and Delegated Identity
LLM Proxy sits between agent and inference endpoint, inspecting every request/response and writing to Teleport's audit log
Per-Beam allow list enforces which agents reach which inference endpoints under what conditions
Delegated Identity lets humans or agents define scoped permissions per agent — no standing credentials, no shared secrets
If agent is compromised, blast radius is bounded by the delegated identity's scoped privileges
Delegated Identity implements zero trust and just-in-time (JIT) access for agents
Alexander Klizhentas (CTO): 'Delegated identity and LLM Proxy unblock enterprise organizations... making a leap from vibe-coding and prototyping to real production engineering'
Beams runs each agent in isolated Firecracker VM with built-in identity, full audit from instantiation to termination
Available now at beams.run

competitors.title: Teleport Adds LLM Proxy and Delegated Identity to Secure AI Agent Actions and Access (Help Net Security, June 16, 2026)
key_points: Addresses critical gap: lack of identity, access control, and auditability at two points in agentic workflow — what agent is instructed to do and what it is permitted to access
Unlike LLM gateways (focused on routing/cost/screening prompts), Teleport's LLM Proxy enforces via the same identity and zero trust plane that governs databases, cloud APIs, and internal services
All activity recorded, analyzed by peer agents, and tied to identity and task
Least-privilege access is a runtime property of every agent
Per-Beam resource allow list governs access to specific endpoints under defined conditions

competitors.title: Teleport Launches Beams — Trusted Agent Runtimes For Infrastructure (Official Press Release, March 19, 2026)
key_points: Beams originally announced as trusted runtime for AI agents — solving security/IAM blockers for production agent deployment
Each Beam runs in isolated Firecracker VM with full filesystem and networking isolation
Beams inherit delegated identity to authenticate to registered services without using secrets
Fine-grained networking control over external and internal services
MVP launched April 30, 2026; public beta with LLM Proxy + Delegated Identity on June 16
Use cases: internal agents needing production access, ephemeral staging workflows, multi-agent production pipelines

competitors.title: Teleport Launches Beams to Provide Trusted Runtimes for AI Agents (Cloud Native Now, March 23, 2026)
key_points: Beams presented at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026
Each Beam has policy-controlled, tracked and auditable access to trusted data sources, infrastructure, and inference services
Ephemeral, isolated environments that are fast to start, locked down, integrated with Teleport identity and audit trails
Designed for internal agents, agentic ephemeral workflows, and multi-agent production pipelines

competitors.title: Teleport Introduces Agentic Identity Framework to Secure AI Agents in Production Infrastructure (Official, January 27, 2026)
key_points: Agentic Identity Framework announced in January 2026 — defines policies, practices, tools, and reference architecture for production agent deployment
69% of 200+ infrastructure leaders surveyed said AI adoption requires significant changes to identity management; only 2% disagreed
Organizations today rely on static secrets, hard-coded credentials, or bespoke configs layered on legacy IAM/PAM
Four framework layers: Identity (cryptographic, ephemeral certificates), Access (MCP proxy, LLM controls), Security (discovery, audit), Scheduling (orchestration, workflows)
Supports open standards: MCP, SPIFFE
Ev Kontsevoy (CEO): 'A unified identity layer is a prerequisite to deploying AI within enterprise infrastructure environments'

competitors.title: Teleport Beams LLM Proxy Brings Delegated Identity to AI Agents (GetAIGovernance, June 17, 2026)
key_points: Beams acts as secure proxy layer between AI models and systems they need to access
Enforces principle of least privilege while enabling agents to perform useful work across enterprise systems
Reflects growing demand for infrastructure-level controls supporting next wave of AI adoption
Part of Teleport's broader Agentic Identity Framework
